insight: The MCP plugin's mounting hook (`hooks.onPluginsLoaded`) is NOT auto-run by `engine.initialize()`; plugin tests that boot a real engine must call `engine.runHooks('onPluginsLoaded')` explicitly to trigger tool mounting. The `server_status` tool is registered in `register()` (always present), but per-server `mcp__<serverId>__*` tools only appear after the hook runs.

Item 9 fixed: listTools now walks all pages via walkAllPages function. The paginateList function's maxListPages/maxListItems caps were truncating the tool list that feeds the ToolMountingCache, meaning mcp__<server>__list_tools only showed a subset of tools to the LLM. The fix adds a dedicated walkAllPages function that only has infinite-loop protection (cursor dedup) and uses it for listTools, while resources/prompts/resourceTemplates still use paginateList with caps.

Fixed stderr-as-transport-error bug in createChildTransport. The function was treating any stderr output from spawned MCP processes as a fatal transport error, which broke servers launched via npx (which prints informational messages to stderr). Changed to log stderr via logger.warn instead, matching the official MCP TypeScript SDK behavior.

The `__mount_tool` return value was returning the internal cache key (e.g., `"web_search"`) instead of the full canonical name (e.g., `"mcp__searxng__web_search"`). This caused agents to try using the wrong name when they read the tool result. Fixed by using `cache.getToolDefName()` to get the short mounted name and prepending `"mcp__"` to form the canonical name. This is a 3-line change in the MCP plugin plus 2 test assertion updates.
